notes: C / R#10: tf close back inside session VWAP +/- band sigma after a close outside -> fade at market
rationale: VWAP fade = mean reversion to fair price (EDGE_SPEC C): a close beyond session VWAP +/- band sigma followed by a close back inside is a failed extension, so the traders who chased it must exit and their orders carry price back toward VWAP.
